_about: The scripted Work model's two runs in tests/computer-real-e2e.test.ts (test 9). Not a model: each step is one assistant turn, and `expect` is a regular expression the previous tool result must match (runner/agent-core/src/work/scripted-model.ts). The page the browser steps read is put in place by the test before the run (a data: URL navigated through the computer's browser by the test itself); the model never navigates.

steps.say: I will work on my computer.

input.command: mkdir -p e2e-run && printf 'from-the-shell' > e2e-run/shell.txt && cat e2e-run/shell.txt

steps.say: Done: a file from the shell, a note through the files tool, and the form field filled in my browser.

steps.expect: ^Started your computer\. Nothing else was done: call computer_shell again
Your browser tool now uses your computer's browser, with its saved sign-ins\.[\s\S]*juno-e2e-marker
steps.say: Done: the computer started after you said yes, and my browser is now its browser.
